status: Development design optimizing the relative-state advantage construct and observable adapters across three temporal hierarchies; not prospective clinical preregistration.

mathematical_construct.equation: uHNDI_v20 = (Phi_target - beta * Phi_ref) / (Phi_target + beta * Phi_ref + gamma * Phi_floor)
mathematical_construct.scale_invariance: Exact degree-0 scale homogeneity: uHNDI_v20(k*T, k*R, k*F) = uHNDI_v20(T, R, F) for any k > 0 at machine precision (< 1e-12).
mathematical_construct.boundedness: Finite range in [-1.0, 1.0] for non-negative inputs and non-negative beta, gamma.
mathematical_construct.singularity_protection: Returns 0.0 when denominator is identically zero.

binder.tuning: Fold-local 3-inner-fold CV selection of beta in [0.0, 0.5, 1.0] and gamma in [0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5] on training folds only.

wielek.floor: sum(p_s for s != N1) = p_wake + p_N2 + p_N3 + p_REM = 1 - p_N1 (Complete Observable Budget Normalization)
wielek.tuning: Fixed parameter-free beta=0.0, gamma=1.0, yielding exact complete recording budget normalization T / (T + F_full).

mendeley.target: theta_power (4-8 Hz spectral power across 6 channels)
mendeley.reference: alpha_power (8-13 Hz spectral power across 6 channels)
mendeley.tuning: Fixed parameter-free beta=1.0, gamma=1.0, yielding exact dimensionless spectral advantage (theta - alpha) / (theta + alpha).

splits: Exactly identical v10 patient roles across all three cohorts (45 Binder, 23 Wielek, 41 Mendeley). No test leakage; zero test data enters any scaler, inner selection, or parameter choice.
metric: Mean outer-fold AUC, then 5-seed mean, then unweighted equal-cohort macro-average AUC.
performance_target: Macro-average AUC exceeding both raw T alone (0.7588) and original uHNDI (0.7836), while preserving exact degree-0 scale homogeneity and reporting full fair comparisons on identical inputs.
